title: A tool returned needing repair is marked as needing repair through the event handler
given: Command handlers sharing one event dispatcher over an in-memory store, with tools on loan: once without the event handler subscribed, once with it, and once with it failing.
when: Loans are returned needing repair with a note, needing repair with a blank note, and in good condition.
then: Without the handler, the return changes only the loan and Tool returned is published with its fields. With it, Damage reported follows Tool returned and the tool needs repair with the return note, or "Returned needing repair." when there is none; a good return invokes nothing. When the handler fails, the return stands and the failure is reported.
